items.description:
Millennium Panelbeaters is a black-owned, family-run panel beating and spray painting workshop in Ladanna, Polokwane, handling body repairs for cars and commercial vehicles. The business is run by three partners who together bring more than thirty-eight years of experience in the motor industry, working alongside a team of skilled, trained and experienced artisans who carry out the repair and respray work.

The workshop is a member of both SAMBRA, the body repairers' association, and the Retail Motor Industry Organisation, and it says it adheres to strict grading specifications in how it delivers its service, with a hands-on approach from the partners rather than management from a distance.

Based in Ladanna, Polokwane, the workshop suits motorists and businesses needing accident or body repair work carried out by an experienced, accredited team close to home.

Polokwane Vet Clinic is a veterinary practice in Polokwane Central that presents itself as the vet to trust in the city. It offers walk-in consultations for pets, from routine check-ups to more complex medical issues, along with vaccinations that protect animals against preventable diseases. The clinic also provides care for livestock and horses, including routine check-ups, treatments and herd and equine health management.

The website also has a pet shop stocking veterinary-approved products, from nutrition to grooming essentials. The clinic is in Unit 5 at the Amnaz Centre on Compensatie Street, and it suits pet owners and farmers who want compassionate, thorough care close to home.

Rheeder Attorneys is a law firm in Polokwane Central providing legal assistance across several areas of practice. Its work includes estate administration, acting as a labour practitioner in workplace disputes, and handling family-related matters such as divorce and maintenance claims, alongside criminal law cases.

This spread of practice areas means the firm serves individuals facing a range of legal needs, from settling a deceased estate or resolving a dispute at work to representing someone through a divorce, a maintenance matter or a criminal charge, rather than focusing on a single specialty.

The firm is based at 56A Hoog Street in Polokwane Central, and suits individuals who want one firm able to handle different kinds of personal and workplace legal matters as they arise.

The store stocks homeware and soft furnishings for the bedroom, living room and bathroom, including bedding, curtains and decor pieces for the home.

As a branch of an established retail chain, it gives Lebowakgomo households a local source for home textiles and decor without having to travel to a larger centre, and it suits shoppers furnishing a new home or simply refreshing a room with new linen or curtains. The store is open Monday from 8am to 2pm, Tuesday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Saturday from 9am to 3pm and Sunday from 9am to 2pm.

items.description:
Skin Deep is a beauty and aesthetics salon in Thornhill Shopping Centre, Polokwane, which was established in 2013 to offer a quality salon that is affordable for women in the city. Its range of treatments covers hair removal, skin treatments and beauty treatments, carried out by highly trained therapists and aestheticians with safety and aftercare in mind.

The salon says its team is committed to high standards of care, product knowledge and procedures, and it works with well-known brands. Clients can book an appointment through the website, and the salon sits at Shop 21 in Thornhill Shopping Centre on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street, so it suits women who want a relaxing treatment close to home.

Ster-Kinekor Mall of the North is a multiplex cinema inside Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane, with six screens showing a mix of current film releases, from major blockbuster titles to family-oriented films. Moviegoers can book seats and buy e-tickets online ahead of a visit, or get tickets and snacks from the concession stand once inside.

The cinema is designed to be accessible to wheelchair users, and self-service kiosks let ticket holders collect pre-booked tickets without queuing at the counter. These features, together with the range of screens on offer, make it a straightforward option for a night out at the movies.

Trading from Mall of the North in Bendor, it suits moviegoers, families and anyone looking for a convenient cinema outing in Polokwane.

SuperSpar Paledi is a full-service supermarket in Paledi Mall, part of the SPAR group, stocking groceries, fresh produce and household goods for the Mankweng area. Alongside the general grocery range, the store operates as a fruit and vegetable supplier and general food products supplier, giving shoppers a wider choice of fresh and packaged goods under one roof.

The supermarket anchors the Paledi Mall site in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, and serves as a convenient grocery option for households in the surrounding area who would otherwise need to travel further into Polokwane for a full supermarket shop.

Based on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, the store suits local households doing a weekly grocery run and anyone needing fresh produce close to home, and is open daily from 7am to 7pm.

items.description:
Zororo Lodge is a guesthouse in Dalmada, Polokwane, which describes itself as a place of tranquillity with serene accommodation. The website presents it as an affordable option in the city, and the lodge offers an authentic African restaurant, a swimming pool area and conference facilities for business events.

The lodge also hosts weddings and private events in its gardens and event spaces, and it says it aims to give guests a warm and inviting atmosphere. Its listing carries a three-star accommodation grading, and it sits on Plot 39-41 in Dalmada, so it suits guests who want a quiet, comfortable stay or a venue for a celebration.

A1 Supermarket is a general grocery and supermarket store in Polokwane Central, stocking everyday groceries and household goods for shoppers across the city. Customers who have reviewed the store describe it as a big, well-stocked supermarket known for affordable prices and significant savings on groceries, making it a popular stop for shoppers from a wide range of backgrounds.

The store can get busy at peak times, reflecting its popularity with regular shoppers, and it is one of the few in the area still accepting cheque payments for in-store purchases. A1 Supermarket trades from 15 Devenish Street in Polokwane Central, and suits households looking for a convenient, no-frills grocery shop with everyday low prices.

Best Bake Bakery is a neighbourhood bakery in Nirvana, Polokwane, selling a range of baked goods including cakes, doughnuts, rolls and croissants for customers to buy in-store or to take away. It is listed locally among Polokwane's bakers and sweet-food retailers, alongside other bakeries serving the wider city.

The bakery serves shoppers in Nirvana and the surrounding suburbs who are after everyday baked goods as well as cakes and treats for special occasions, and it operates as a straightforward local bakery rather than a large chain outlet. Callsave is a security and telecommunications provider operating from Bendor Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, offering CCTV systems for homes and businesses alongside VOIP telephone systems, solar power systems and network and fibre connectivity solutions. Its services span both the security and communications sides of a property, from camera monitoring to everyday phone and internet connections.

The business combines these services for local customers, so a CCTV installation can be arranged alongside everyday telecoms needs such as phone, internet and power options. Callsave also keeps an after-hours contact line for support outside normal business hours, and suits homeowners and businesses around Polokwane who want security monitoring and communications services handled by the same local provider.

Clicks The Greenery is a branch of the national Clicks pharmacy and health-and-beauty retail chain, trading from The Greenery shopping centre on the corner of Oost and Grobler Street in Polokwane Extension 4. The branch combines a retail store with an in-house pharmacy, each listed with its own separate trading hours on the store's own page, so pharmacy services remain available even when they differ from the rest of the shop.

Shoppers can use the store for everyday health, beauty and personal-care products, while the pharmacy side handles dispensing and related pharmacy services for patients in the area. It suits customers in and around The Greenery who want to combine a pharmacy visit with general health and beauty shopping while in Polokwane.

items.description:
Debonairs Pizza Mall@Lebo is a branch of the national pizza and fast-food chain, trading from Shop 52 inside Mall@Lebo in Lebowakgomo. The branch offers Debonairs' well-known Triple-Decker range alongside the more affordable Real Deal range, along with other pizzas and sides made to order for eating in, takeaway or delivery.

Customers can order online for home delivery or collect their order in person at the Mall@Lebo branch, which trades seven days a week. It suits families, groups and individual customers in Lebowakgomo looking for a quick pizza meal, a takeaway order or delivery straight to their door, whether for a weeknight meal or a weekend gathering.

Devenish Guest House is an old-fashioned country-style guest house with a family pub and grill, on Devenish Street in Polokwane. It has nine fully furnished units, each with an en-suite bathroom, tea and coffee facilities, and linen and bath towels provided, and units 6 and 7 can be used for self-catering with a fully equipped kitchen.

Guests can use free Wi-Fi, the restaurant, lounge and bar, a well-kept garden and entertainment area, and secure parking. The property has a security gate with 24-hour surveillance cameras, an airport shuttle, a wheelchair-friendly layout and a separate smoking nook, with no smoking rooms. It suits families and travellers who want a comfortable stay with a pub and grill on site.

Dis-Chem TLC Market Street is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy group, trading from 62 Market Street in Polokwane Central with both a retail pharmacy and an in-store clinic. Shoppers can use Click & Collect for online orders, while the clinic offers health services on a separate schedule from the main pharmacy and store.

The clinic's schedule is more limited than the pharmacy's, including restricted Saturday availability that falls only on the first and last Saturday of each month, reflecting its focus on scheduled health services rather than everyday walk-in retail. Dis-Chem has operated as a South African pharmacy group since 1978, and this Market Street branch suits customers in Polokwane Central who need prescription medicines, clinic care or everyday health and beauty shopping.
